# PR slice can link into out-of-scope components and mark them internal

A new module introduced in a PR can import a symbol from an out-of-scope module; the compile records that dependency and classifies the out-of-scope module as an internal dependency (not external). The test asserts internal_dependencies include billing.rules.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental.test_pr_slice_links_into_out_of_scope_components`
